messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — Sparrow-3 v1 weights have been staged and I want to coordinate onboarding + the customer-facing blurb. Path: s3://redwood-models/sparrow3/v1/weights.tar.gz and tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/sparrow3/v1/tokenizer.model. Planning to announce next Tue if we’re green. Who can take the docs/announcements draft?

ben: I checked the bucket. There are two weight sets: `fp16/` (full) and `int8/` (quantized). Int8 is experimental — put it in `int8-approx/`. Also there
are separate config files: `model_config.yaml` and `kv_cache_config.json` in the root.

carmen: FYI tokenizer is SentencePiece but has a non-standard reserved token `<|sep|>` at id 50265 that breaks some of our default detokenization. If you run `tokenizer.decode()` on sequences with consecutive separators you'll get extra spaces. Patch suggestion below.

carmen: ```
# patch to tokenizer_config.json
{"model_type":"sentencepiece","do_lower_case":false,"special_tokens":{"sep":"<|sep|>","eos":"</s>"},"legacy_detokenize_fix":true}
```

dan: Running the config validator (tools/validate_model.py) against the model dir returned two warnings and one critical: critical = kv_cache mismatch (expected 512k, got 256k). That will break long-context evals. Command I used: `python tools/validate_model.py --model-dir s3://redwood-models/sparrow3/v1 --strict`.

ben: Good catch. The weights were exported with a smaller TPU-compatible cache. We need to regenerate the runtime config with `--kv-cache-size 524288` during export, or add a compatibility mapping in runtime that upgrades the cache automatically. I'd prefer re-export.

maya: Re-export is ok but timeline? We want canary next Wed. If re-export takes >48h that pushes the announcement. Anyone available to run export tomorrow? @ben @dan

eva: I can spin up an export job tomorrow AM and follow up with a small smoke test. I
will also draft the announcement copy and a short "known quirks" list. Can someone drop capability notes I should highlight?

ben: Capability notes (short): strong instruction following, very good summarization on 1-4k context, decent code assistance for Python/JS, worse on math/long reasoning. Perf: 18-22 tokens/s on a single A10G for fp16 full; int8 improves throughput but watch quality regression ~2-3% on our evals.

carmen: Known quirks to include: tokenizer splits emoji clusters, whitespace diff with `<|sep|>` as noted, and a rare EOS duplication when streaming with `stream=true` + function calling.

dan: On the docs side, include the recommended runtime config snippet we validated. Small example to put in the onboarding doc:

```yaml
model_alias: "sparrow-3"
model_path: "/mnt/models/sparrow3/v1"
device: "cuda"
precision: "fp16"
kv_cache_size: 524288
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  latency_slo_ms: 200
fallbacks:
  - "sparrow-2-mini"
```

maya: That looks good. For naming conventions: let's use public alias `sparrow-3` and internal version tag `sparrow-3@v1`. Avoid hyphen variants in the user-visible name (we keep it simple).

eva: Draft announcement copy (first pass):

"We
re excited to add Sparrow-3 to the Redwood catalog. Sparrow-3 is tuned for instruction-following and summarization; recommended for chat, summarization, and short-form code assistance. Defaults: `fp16` serving for best quality; `int8` available as an experimental option with notable throughput gains and small quality trade-offs. Known quirks: emoji/tokenization edge-cases, occasional EOS duplication when streaming. See docs for migration notes and config examples: https://redwood.internal/docs/models/sparrow-3"

maya: Nice. Add a short note about fallback policy and SLA: "canary → staged → GA; automatic fallback to `sparrow-2-mini` if serving variant fails." Also cc product and support channels for post-GA messaging.

ben: PRs: docs PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/479 (wip). Runtime changes/compat mapping PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1123 (ben).

carmen: Small QA checklist I
pushed: run tokenization roundtrip on 1000 random samples, run streaming smoke test, validate function-calling example, and run the long-context regression suite. I
ve added steps in the PR description.

maya: Plan:
- Tue AM: export with kv_cache fix (eva/ben)
- Tue afternoon: run validator + smoke tests (carmen/dan)
- Wed AM: canary deployment to staging cluster, run canary suite (eng-oncall)
- Wed afternoon: cut announcement draft, get reviews from product/support/legal
- Thu: GA (contingent on canary)

deploy-bot: :info: Canary deployment job queued for `staging-sparrow3-canary` (job 86721). Status: queued.

eva: I'll take the export tomorrow and update this thread with job logs and the first smoke test summary. I'll also push the announcement draft to PR #479 and ping product for review.

maya: Great — thanks everyone. If we hit any blocker, post here and tag @maya.

ben: tiny note — if anyone uses the `int8` folder in production, make sure to attach `--approx-quant` flag in runtime to enable our int8-dequant patch. Otherwise you'll see off-by-one logits in some cases.

carmen: Also adding a quick tip to the docs: when streaming with `stream=true`, include a debounce of 50ms client-side to avoid duplicate EOS events for some tokenizers.

maya: Closing loop: will wait for eva's export update. Thanks all :thumbsup:
